name: nevermined-catalog-onboarding
description: Onboard an external builder's x402 service into the Nevermined Agent Services Catalog end-to-end: pick the routable endpoint, prove it charges and works by paying it directly from a wallet (raw EOA + EIP-3009), register the agent, publish and promote the listing, then run a real paid e2e through the Nevermined Router. Covers ownership and claiming, and when a listing becomes payable with subscription credits.
